20 SIGNATURES. ONE PROOF.
Daisugi v0.3 aggregates 20 transaction signatures using LeanSPHINCS and LeanVM.
20 SPHINCS signatures are verified through a single aggregate proof.
For EL clients, verification requires the LeanVM verifier plus the LeanSPHINCS guest program.
Post quantum signature aggregation is live on Daisugi. Kudos to @Nethermind @Gianluca_Felli

AND THEN THERE WERE FRAMES.
Daisugi v0.2 now supports Frame Transactions.
SPHINCS signed transactions can run as native frames, with per frame execution and verification, alongside the existing ERC 4337 flow.
Same post quantum signatures. New transaction model.
Next: signature aggregation via LeanSPHINCS.
Believe in somETHing. Link and credits ⬇️

text:
The sudden collapse of the value of CoT (even summarized CoT) in the agentic era changes working with AI.

Effectively steering AIs and getting any sort of observability now requires you to ask for interim outputs & tests, and to use AI help to troubleshoot problems you find.

It used to be that you could look at the CoT from a request and get a sense of where the model was going, but with tons of agents calling other agents, and CoTs that run to thousands of pages for even simple agentic tasks, that is no longer possible.

It also requires you to trust the orchestrator model more than ever, since it is the only thing that can track all of the tasks. Which means you need to use AI to both find problems with AI and to troubleshoot problems you find.
